question: Run manifests (WORKFLOW § Idle batches rule 6): HA-PR-#460 makes nen's manifest the one owner and keeps only a small Hatsu ownership record. Confirm that split?

options.label: nen owns the run (Recommended)
options.consequence: nen's manifest is the single run record; Hatsu keeps only the ownership stub; the then-gate reads nen's manifest

options.label: Hatsu keeps its own
options.consequence: Hatsu keeps a full manifest beside nen's (two records, as before)
